title: COOL KNIGHT Herb Grinder [large capacity/fast/Electric ]-Spice Herb Coffee Grinder with Pollen Catcher/- 7.5" (Black)
description:
About this item
Large-capacity, fast grinder for herbs: Can quickly complete grinding 120g of herbs or spices within 5 to 10 seconds; Its visual-lid design allows you to control the coarse or fine grinding state with one hand only; It takes 3 to 5 seconds for coarse grinding, and 8 to15 seconds for fine grinding only.
Powerful multi-function grinder: Suitable for grinding herbs, spices, pollen, coffee beans, etc., meeting all your needs on grinding, and solving other problems like slow grinding, low capacity, long grinding time, inability to control coarseness, etc. It saves you a lot of time for doing other meaningful things.
One-button operation and safety design: Its design includes a simple push-down-power operation, and the lid is used as a switch; Just a gentle press, the grinder will start grinding, and only stop till you lift your hand from the lid. You can also keep pressing the lid within different time length so as to control the coarse, medium and fine grinding state. In addition, it makes the grinder safer, since the blade will only start to rotate when the lid is on the cup and pressed down.
Material and technology: The inner tank of the grinder is made of 304 stainless steel. The blade is made of high-quality stainless steel, which is quite durable; Unique shape of the blade allows grinding in all 360-degree directions. And it runs at a speed of 30,000 rotations per minute, which enables the grinder to complete its work quickly.
Easy to be cleaned-A complimentary brush is included in the package, which can be used to clean the stainless steel grinder easily. The power cord is detachable, so you can store it with ease and save space.

UPDATE: This thing is so annoying to work with, and incredibly noisy. After 4 days of use it doesn't even work half the time when plugged in. Just spend a little more money, don't do what I did and try to be cheap. You're gonna just buy another grinder that's better later.

---

ORIGINAL:

I bought it to replace a lost hand grinder. I use this to grind legal herbs, you know the ones. It works fine for that, easy to use, not too big a pain to clean if you stay on it after each use. Grinds things up well and consistently.

It's a 3 because of two things:

1) The noise level is not great. I expected some noise, but this thing sounds like if you took a vacuum cleaner and set the volume at 50% - so still pretty loud. If I lived alone in a house I wouldn't care but I live in an apartment with people around, and this thing can definitely be heard through the walls whenever I use it. So the problem now is that if I want to do an early morning or late-night session, I still have to grind/cut by hand so I don't disturb my neighbors. If it's past midnight, doing even a ten second grind on this thing is liable to get a pound on my wall or door. So if you need something quiet and discreet, this ain't it.

2) Speaking of late night sessions, I forgot to put the pollen catcher on ONCE before grinding and it was a complete and total disaster. Without that pollen catcher the ground herbs will fly up and out of the container and get stuck in the outer rim between the cover and the metal inner part, and also spill out all around the grinder. It's completely insane that they made it this way. If you buy it just come to terms with the fact that you will eventually forget to put pollen catcher cap on for one of the times you use it and will have to deal with a similar mess.

TLDR: it's fine, it does its job, but I wouldn't buy it again. If you don't care about noise level and believe you have the mental fortitude to never, ever forget to put the pollen catcher on before you start grinding, go for it.
